choices.A: Build it in any direction; the length is the same.
choices.B: Build it in a direction parallel to \(l\).
choices.C: Draw a perpendicular to \(l\) through point \(P\) and build along the perpendicular segment, because the perpendicular segment is the shortest.
choices.D: Build it along the segment connecting \(P\) to any point on the riverbank.

question: How should the shortest canal from river \(l\) to village \(P\) be built?
solution: Among the segments connecting a point outside a line to points on the line, the perpendicular segment is the shortest, so building the canal along the perpendicular segment gives the shortest canal.
